messages:
alex.k: Heads-up — I'm putting together an observability view for continuous flow batching. Goal: capture batch_utilization, queue_depth (histogram), tokens_per_sec, per-kernel latency breakdown, and KV cache hit/miss. Any preferences on labels or sampling?

maria.s: Love it. Suggest labels: model_name, kernel_variant, seq_len_bucket. Also add kv_cache_hit_ratio and a small scatter for miss latency.

jayc: FYI I ran into a perf regression yesterday that looks like a kernel fallback path triggering on certain seq_len distributions. Saw ~5-8ms extra per token when fallback happens on redwood-large-k. Uploaded a quick flamegraph to our perf bucket (link in #eng-runtime-artifacts).

noah_r: We should expose token_budget_remaining per route so upstream can decide to abort/trim. Also capture tokens/sec with p50/p90/p99, and include a per-model sampling (1%) for high-cardinality traces.

infra-bot: :warning: alert triggered: batch_utilization < 0.2 for >5m on prod-us-west-2 cluster. Incident ID: infra-4821.

alex.k: Thanks — proposed PromQL snippets to start the dashboard:
- batch_utilization (approx): sum(rate(batch_work_seconds_total[1m])) / sum(machine_capacity_seconds)
- queue_depth p95: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(queue_depth_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_name, kernel_variant))
- tokens_per_sec by kernel: sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (kernel_variant)
Also want kv_cache_miss_scatter by seq_len_bucket.

maria.s: :thumbsup: For token_budget_remaining metric use labels route=/v2/generate model=<model>. Sample traces at 1% to avoid cardinality explosion.

jayc: Add kernel_selection_reason label (optimal|fallback|quantized) — super helpful when investigating regressions. If we see fallback: true then check fallback_reason tag.

noah_r: I'll add a lightweight trace hook to record first-request-kvstate and kernel choice. Sampling 0.5% should be fine.

maria.s: Can we add an alert: median per-token latency for kernel_variant increases >10% over baseline for 30m? That would have caught yesterday's issue earlier.

alex.k: Yes. Plan: alerts for batch_util drop, token/sec regression, and kernel-latency drift. Runbook: rollback kernel version or force alternate kernel_variant/quantized path, flush small cache if KV cache skew suspected. I'll sketch the runbook in ops docs.

infra-bot: deployed metric exporter changes (kernel_selection_reason, kv_cache_hit_ratio) to prod (exporter v3.4.1).

jayc: I'll run a controlled perf sweep tomorrow and post results here. Thanks all.
__notes: single-thread Slack export: messages are a continuous string with sender prefixes; root ts = thread_ts
